entries.content: VERIFIED. Phase A canonical scene game/scenes/vehicles/jordan_1995/jordan_1995.tscn holds geometry/layout, collision, wheels and the reference powertrain placeholder. Phase B scene jordan_1995_phase_b.tscn inherits Phase A and overrides mechanical grip/brakes/differential (front_brake_bias 0.57, rear_locking_differential_engage_torque 170, contact_patch 0.21, braking_grip_multiplier 1.08, surface dicts). Test scene game/scenes/tracks/test_field/jordan_handling_test.tscn instances phase_b with Formula90s controller/aids/HUD. Phase B values are FROZEN for Phase C (PROJECT_STATE 5.3).

VERIFIED. Vehicle root is RigidBody3D with class_name Vehicle (game/addons/gevp/scripts/vehicle.gd, extends RigidBody3D). It owns physics integration: center_of_mass_mode CUSTOM set in initialize() (vehicle.gd:456-460); mass from vehicle_mass; CG from front_weight_distribution lerp between axle positions plus center_of_gravity_height_offset; inertia = body inertia * inertia_multiplier (vehicle.gd:616-622). Physics tick 120 Hz (game/project.godot). Stability/yaw forces in process_stability() (vehicle.gd:946-972). vehicle.gd is not treated as pristine upstream (PROJECT_STATE 4.3).

entries.topic: Wheel RayCast suspension and brush tire model
entries.content: VERIFIED. Each wheel is a RayCast3D with class_name Wheel (game/addons/gevp/scripts/wheel.gd). Suspension: raycast target length spring_length + tire_radius; spring compression in mm; spring force + antiroll + damping + bottom-out force in process_suspension() (wheel.gd:204-266); spring rate from vehicle.gd:1074-1077, damping from vehicle.gd:1079-1080. Tire force: brush model with friction = current_cof * spring_force - (spring_force / (tire_width * contact_patch * 0.2)) at wheel.gd:301 (tire width reduces load sensitivity). Surface detected from first node group of the collider matching coefficient_of_friction keys. Forces applied at wheel contact with torque-to-body multiplier (wheel.gd:177-194).

VERIFIED. mass 505 kg, front_weight_distribution 0.45, center_of_gravity_height_offset -0.20 m, inertia_multiplier 1.10. Wheelbase 2.93 m (front RayCasts z=-1.4394, rear z=+1.4906). Tracks: front 1.4788 m (X +/-0.739368), rear 1.4370 m (X +/-0.718479). Collision: CollisionTub box (0.92,0.40,2.35) at (0,0.02,0.18); CollisionNose box (0.44,0.24,1.45) at (0,-0.08,-1.43); CollisionRear box (0.88,0.32,1.00) at (0,0.00,1.4812).

VERIFIED. Radii 0.3473 m both axles; widths front 335 / rear 420 mm (NOT 1995-era, see backlog PHY-003); wheel mass 12/16 kg; contact_patch 0.21; braking_grip_multiplier 1.08. Surface dicts (Phase B): tire_stiffnesses Road 8.75 / Curb 7.0 / Gravel 0.5 / Grass 0.5; coefficient_of_friction Road 2.65 / Curb 2.2 / Gravel 1.1 / Grass 0.9; rolling_resistance Road 1.0 / Curb 1.5 / Gravel 2.0 / Grass 4.0; lateral_grip_assist Road 0.02 others 0.0; longitudinal_grip_ratio Road 0.48 others 0.45.

VERIFIED baseline (Phase A, known-good): front/rear spring_length 0.15 m; resting_ratio 0.50; damping_ratio 0.75; bump_damp_multiplier 1.3; rebound_damp_multiplier 1.1; arb_ratio front 0.45 / rear 0.40; camber -0.0174533 rad (-1 deg); toe 0.0017453 rad; bump_stop_multiplier 1.0; beam_axle false. Spring rate derived from resting compression (vehicle.gd:1074-1077); damping = ratio * 2 * sqrt(rate * weight) * 0.01 (vehicle.gd:1079-1080).

VERIFIED baseline: steering_speed 4.25, countersteer_speed 11.0, steering_speed_decay 0.20, steering_slip_assist 0.15, countersteer_assist 0.9, steering_exponent 1.5, max_steering_angle 0.4363323 rad (25 deg), front_steering_ratio 1.0, rear_steering_ratio 0.0. Steering smoothing/exponent/countersteer logic in vehicle.gd:664-723; Ackermann computed from wheelbase and track in vehicle.gd:554-556.

VERIFIED: front_brake_bias 0.57 (manual, not auto-derived); brake_force_multiplier 1.0; ABS front/rear pulse 0.03 s, spin difference threshold 12.0; rear_locking_differential_engage_torque 170 Nm, front disabled (-1.0); rear_torque_vectoring 0.0; traction_control_max_slip 8.0. max_brake_force auto-computed from average tire friction in vehicle.gd:1064-1067.

VERIFIED placeholder (NOT 1995-spec): max_torque 280 Nm, max_rpm 17000, idle_rpm 4500; torque_curve points (0, 0.2), (0.85, 1.0), (1.0, 0.1); motor_drag 0.005, motor_brake 15.0, motor_moment 0.12; clutch_out_rpm 5000, max_clutch_torque_ratio 1.4; gear_ratios [2.85, 2.29, 1.89, 1.60, 1.38, 1.20] (6 gears), final_drive 3.60, reverse_ratio 3.00; shift_time 0.12 s; automatic_transmission true; automatic_time_between_shifts 700 ms; gear_inertia 0.03. Motor/clutch model vehicle.gd:748-816; auto-shift logic vehicle.gd:818-868 (upshifts when ideal no-slip wheel RPM exceeds max_rpm). Target 1995 Peugeot A10 spec in backlog PHY-008/PHY-009.

VERIFIED: coefficient_of_drag 0.95, frontal_area 1.50 m^2, air_density 1.225 kg/m^3. Drag applied in vehicle.gd:640-643 (0.5 * rho * v^2 * A * Cd). NO downforce layer exists in game/addons/formula90s (gap; backlog PHY-012).

VERIFIED. game/addons/formula90s/scripts/driving_aids.gd toggles 5 aids via input actions aid_1..aid_5: [0] AUTO transmission, [1] stability (multiplies stability_yaw_strength x2, floor 4.0), [2] steering (steering_exponent x1.5), [3] braking (brake_force_multiplier x1.5), [4] grip (coefficient_of_friction x1.3 floor 1.5, lateral_grip_assist +0.15). Defaults [true, false, false, false, false]. Baseline captured in _ready() and restored on toggle-off.

VERIFIED. TelemetryManager (game/addons/formula90s/scripts/telemetry_manager.gd) writes CSV only to res://telemetry/ at 50 ms sampling with columns: Time_ms, Speed_kmh, RPM, Gear, Throttle, Brake, Steering, Lat_G, Long_G, FL/FR/RL/RR_Comp, Front_Slip, Rear_Slip. NO _setup.json pairing exists (verified gap; backlog PHY-001). Toggled by main menu CheckButton (game/scenes/ui/telemetry_toggle.gd). Historical captures in game/telemetry/ lack setup provenance and cannot be attributed to a setup.

VERIFIED. tools/physics_diagnostics/ contains offline Python diagnostics (suspension, powertrain, tires, aero/weight, telemetry) plus tscn_parser.py. Defaults still mirror f1_2026_car.tscn (mass 708 kg, radius 0.370 m) and do NOT match the Jordan Phase B scene (verified gap; backlog PHY-002). Scripts support CLI overrides.

EXTERNAL REFERENCE (not runtime config). Jordan 195 (1995): Peugeot A10 3.0L 72-degree V10 naturally aspirated, 700-760 hp @ 15500 rpm (Wikipedia; other sources lower), 7-speed semi-automatic transmission, minimum weight 595 kg incl. driver (~505-520 kg dry), front track 1700 mm / rear track 1618 mm, wheelbase 2950 mm, Goodyear slick tires ~254 mm front / ~325 mm rear (1993-1997 width rules). Used as tuning target for backlog PHY-003/004/005/008/009.
